name: Press Release Template
author: pressreleasereviews

sections.description: A customizable press release example template that you can use to write your next press release. Write a new press release quickly with our free sample press release example template. Access to free press release templates for your next press release. For more information about the plugin or for plugin support please visit us online at https://pressreleasereviews.com
sections.installation: 1. Upload, install and then activate the plugin through your wordpress plugin panel or extract and upload the zip files contents directly to the directory /wp-content/plugins/press-release-template and then go to the installed plugins page and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
What minimum version of WordPress is required?

This plugin requires minimum version 5.4 or later of WordPress.

What are the licensing terms?

This plugin is available for free under the GNU General Public License, Version 2.

What is the latest tested version of WordPress this is compatible with?

This plugin has been tested up to version 7.0 of WordPress.

Does this plugin have any issues with any other plugins or themes?

This plugin is safe and fully tested with all current version of WordPress. Works fine with all other plugins, works perfectly with yoast wordpress seo plugin, contact form 7, akismet, also jetpack, and also works perfectly with any theme, no compatibility issues with any plugins or any other themes. This plugin is tested and safe for your wp site or blog and fully responsive and tested in all browsers.

How can i find more information about the plugin?

For any additional questions please contact support at anytime. You can use our contact form on our website or contact support through our email – Contact Support
